outputs: company_score = damped confidence-weighted MEAN of opinionated industry/financial nodes + event + capital - risk - valuation_pressure - priced_in (mvp20/scoring.py:362-477)
base_score = fundamental + expectation_gap + valuation_rerating + capital_sentiment - risk - priced_in (mvp20/scoring.py:538)
short/medium/long_total = static reweights of the SAME six components via SPEC28_DEFAULT_HORIZON_MIX (mvp20/scoring.py:89-108,540-554)

market_adjusted_final_score = base * exp(kappa*Σ w_i*f_i) multiplier + local scores - discounts (mvp20/market_adapter.py:115-174); empirically ≈ identity for A-shares (multiplier median 1.007, scoring.py:177-178 R-5 note)
trading_signal BUY/HOLD/WATCH/AVOID from ABSOLUTE thresholds 0.20/-0.15/-0.50 on market-adjusted base (scoring.py:194-196, applied 1793-1797)
mode = 7-state rule classifier (scoring.py:618-829) + mode_confidence (rule-gating average, scoring.py:832-848 — NOT a probability)
derive-layer L11.short/mid/long.score + L11.mode + L11.trade.signal snapshot dp_ids — audit_only, participates_in_score=false (mvp20/derive.py:1676-1729)

probability_calibration.evidence: No P(up) anywhere in mvp20/. The only probability-shaped objects are industry_graphs priors.state_probabilities — validated for sum-to-1 by mvp20/graph.py:341-376 and consumed by NOTHING numeric (served raw to frontend via handle_industry_graph server.py:271-297). trading_signal buckets carry no win-rate semantics; mode_confidence is a rule-average.

forward_return_supervision.evidence: Zero references to realized/forward returns in mvp20/*.py (grep). Production /api/backtest + /api/project-ult/backtests return an EMPTY FIXTURE {backtests: [], total: 0} (mvp20/adapters/audit_eval.py:44-48). The only supervision is the ISOLATED, manually-run pit_backtest/ harness (scripts/run_pit_backtest.py) whose outputs land in docs/audit/ markdown — no production loop reads them back.

walk_forward_evaluation_loop.evidence: Every calibration constant is hand-tuned on a single current-day cross-section: SIGNAL_* thresholds re-anchored on 'the 116-stock base distribution' of one snapshot (scoring.py:174-196 R-5 comment), _INDUSTRY_TOTAL_SCALE K=2.0 'calibrated on the post-L0-wiring A-share distribution' (scoring.py:127-140). The code itself admits the gap: 'to be validated by the point-in-time backtest rather than hand-tuned' (scoring.py:190-193). pit_backtest exists but is one-shot research, not a loop.

regime_layer.evidence: market_regime_multiplier score_target exists (scoring.py:1337, aggregator.py:339) fed by L7.env.market_trend et al. (config/data_point_roles.yaml:2480-2549) into market_adapter factor 'market_regime' with CN_A weights short 0.08 / mid 0.21 / long 0.39 (config/market_adapters.yaml). liquid_universe_gating.evidence: No turnover/size/ST/liquidity filter anywhere in scoring or the /score handler — every onboarded stock gets an equally-confident signal. peer_context builds valuation/industry pools only (mvp20/peer_context.py:98-166), no liquidity pool. All research alpha (REPORT.md/REPORT_PROB.md) exists ONLY in liquid-70; microcap artifact is the documented default failure mode — production has no defense.

horizon_consistent_labeling.evidence: Horizons are produced by (a) keyword matching dp_id/node_name to fixed (short,med,long) weight vectors (aggregator._classify_horizon, mvp20/aggregator.py:297-315) and (b) static component reweights (scoring.py:89-108). No horizon was ever fit or validated against a matching forward-return window (5/10/20d). trading_signal is horizon-blind by construction: _trading_signal_from_mix(base, base, base) (scoring.py:1793-1797).

cross_sectional_semantics.evidence: R-3 peer_context cross-sectionalizes a few INPUTS (valuation percentile pools; analyst-rating re-centering aggregator.py:1090-1102), but the OUTPUT is per-stock absolute; no endpoint ranks the universe, no decile semantics, BUY% drifts with data-coverage changes (the R-5 comment documents base shifting ~0.16 from a governance fix alone, scoring.py:180-190).

trace_industry_graphs.question: do priors/shock_model/prediction_target feed NUMERIC scoring?
details: prediction_target (config/industry_graphs/AI_COMPUTE.yaml:25-27): 'r_i_h = market_beta*r_market + sector_beta*r_sector + alpha_i_h — 预测剥离大盘与行业贝塔后的 alpha'. This equation is YAML PROSE. Nothing in mvp20/ ever computes a beta, fetches an index return, or strips market/sector return. The numeric pipeline scores absolute bullishness — it does not even target the quantity the spec defines.
shock_model (AI_COMPUTE.yaml:36-52): Shock_eff with PricedIn_pre decay D_pre and post-reaction decay D_post — never implemented; production priced_in is the separate run_up field channel.
state_probabilities / valuation_mix / tail_risk mu_adjusted formula: structurally validated by mvp20/graph.py:335-438 (_validate_priors checks types and sum-to-1) and never evaluated.

edges with beta_positive/beta_negative/threshold/lag: validated by graph.py, ZERO references in aggregator.py — the causal graph never propagates anything numerically. aggregate_company_graph only walks the stock overlay's parent_node tree (mvp20/aggregator.py:2017-2148) and uses industry_overlay solely for value inheritance (aggregator.py:1988-2013).

Consumers of industry_graphs yaml: (1) graph.py validators, (2) server.py handle_industry_graph:271-297 raw passthrough to frontend, (3) overlays.py:603,701 records the path string base_industry_graph as LLM-planning context for Codex overlay fill. That is all.

trace_event_coefficient.question: how does the one VALIDATED enhancer enter the system?
trace_event_coefficient.answer: Display-only. The validated coefficient reaches /market-events; base_score instead ingests the SAME payload through a different, UNVALIDATED encoding.
details: forecast_coefficient (mvp20/event_coefficient.py:70-97, type-conditional _BASE_ABN + magnitude scaling, validated=True, h=1) is imported ONLY by handle_market_events (mvp20/server.py:650,669) with 90-day staleness filter and honest caveats metadata. Exemplary honesty contract.

score path: compute_company_score's `event` term comes from aggregated_nodes['company_event_score'] which the aggregator NEVER writes (grep: zero emit sites; scoring.py:1627-1629 comment 'not yet computed by A1; default to 0') → the §27.3 event channel is structurally 0 in production.

MEANWHILE L9.company.earnings_guidance DOES enter base_score via governance: data_point_roles.yaml:3068-3079 routes it to expectation_gap, and aggregator._realtime_field_signal maps it as tanh(mean(change_pct_min,max)/100) (mvp20/aggregator.py:1057-1066) — ignoring the validated type-conditional calibration, ignoring the h=1-day validity horizon (expectation_gap is horizon-agnostic, damped-mean, no ann_date decay beyond generic recency), ignoring the short-leg-survivorship caveat.
Net: TWO parallel encodings of the same event; the validated one cannot reach the score, the unvalidated one does. There is no registration path 'validated research coefficient → scoring channel'.

integration_blueprint.principle: Per REPORT_PROB.md §3/§6: P(up) ⊥ E[ret]; fusion into one number is empirically destructive (tail misalignment). Therefore the two-layer model attaches as PARALLEL OUTPUTS, never as terms inside base_score.

two_layer_model.what: mag_score = ew(sue, npq_yoy) → exp_excess(+20d)+q10–q90; prob_score = ew(-rvol_20,-ivol_60,-max5,-turnover_20,+ep_ttm) → p_beat_median. Spec in factor_research/model/final_model.json, product demo emit_score.py.
where: New pure module mvp20/quant_score.py modeled on event_coefficient.py's honesty contract: returns {mag_score_pct, exp_excess_20d, q10_q90, p_beat_median, horizon_days, validated, caveats, regime} — pure function, no I/O, unit-testable.

Compute in the derive layer (precedent: L11.tech.*, L11.short/mid/long.score) writing new dp_ids L11.quant.mag / L11.quant.prob with participates_in_score=false (audit_only) — shadow mode first, exactly how L11.trade.signal is handled (derive.py:1682-1693).
Surface in /score envelope as a SEPARATE block (e.g. quant_forecast: {prob, magnitude}) next to — not inside — final_score; and optionally in /market-events-style UI with validated flags.
Inputs already collected: hfq bars (L11.tech pipeline), MV, turnover; SUE/npq_yoy from income-statement collector; calibration tables frozen from final_model.json walk-forward fit.
must_not: Sum either layer into base_score / fundamental / capital_sentiment (proven destructive: REPORT_PROB decisive-negative fusion).
Emit absolute P(up) (uncalibratable, day base-rate 0.12–0.97); only market-relative p_beat_median.
Emit for illiquid names: gate on liquid-70 membership computed in build_peer_context (natural attachment — it already scans the universe); outside the gate emit validated:false / null.

event_coefficient_into_score.minimal_change: Make forecast_coefficient the single source of truth for the earnings_guidance signal: replace the ad-hoc tanh(change_pct/100) branch in aggregator._realtime_field_signal (aggregator.py:1057-1066) with a call to event_coefficient.forecast_coefficient, routed to a SHORT-horizon-only additive channel with explicit ann_date decay (e.g. → 0 after ~5 trading days), not the horizon-agnostic expectation_gap damped mean.
event_coefficient_into_score.must_not: Keep both encodings live (double count); let an h=1-validated alpha leak into medium/long totals.

Add a scheduled job that T+5/10/20 later joins stored base_score/trading_signal/L11.quant.* with realized hfq returns (pit_backtest/metrics.py rank-IC machinery is import-reusable), writes monthly rank-IC / top-decile-excess / signal-bucket hit-rates to a runtime table, and serve it from the currently-empty /api/project-ult/backtests fixture (adapters/audit_eval.py:44-48).
